boards.school_name: The University of Texas at Dallas
boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented UT Dallas study environments, from silent library floors to campus common areas and reservable rooms.

cards.entity_name: Eugene McDermott Library Fourth Floor Silent Study
cards.title: McDermott Library Fourth Floor
cards.subtitle: Silent study at Eugene McDermott Library
cards.notes: Bring independent work and silence devices before settling in; this floor is designated for silent study only, without study groups or casual talking.
cards.short_summary: A library floor explicitly designated for silent, individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: McDermott Library designates its fourth floor as “No Noise” and “Silent Study Only,” with no study groups or casual talking.
cards.source_title: Library Policies | UT Dallas Eugene McDermott Library
cards.access_notes: UT Dallas affiliates use a valid Comet Card at library security gates; visitors must present government-issued photo ID and check in.

cards.entity_name: Eugene McDermott Library Third Floor Quiet Study
cards.title: McDermott Library Third Floor
cards.subtitle: Low-noise study at Eugene McDermott Library
cards.notes: Use this level for focused reading or solo work, keeping any necessary conversation to a brief whisper and taking extended discussions elsewhere.
cards.short_summary: A low-noise library level for work that benefits from a quiet setting.
cards.evidence_claim: McDermott Library designates the third floor as low-noise quiet study, allowing only brief whispered conversation about work.
cards.source_title: Library Policies | UT Dallas Eugene McDermott Library
cards.access_notes: UT Dallas affiliates use a valid Comet Card at library security gates; visitors must present government-issued photo ID and check in.

cards.entity_name: Eugene McDermott Library Second Floor Quiet Study
cards.title: McDermott Library Second Floor
cards.subtitle: Low-noise study at Eugene McDermott Library
cards.notes: Choose a table here for concentrated work; keep devices on headphones and move study-group conversations into a room or the designated group areas.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-study level with clear expectations for low-volume individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: McDermott Library designates the second floor as low-noise quiet study and limits study groups to study rooms.
cards.source_title: Library Policies | UT Dallas Eugene McDermott Library
cards.access_notes: UT Dallas affiliates use a valid Comet Card at library security gates; visitors must present government-issued photo ID and check in.

cards.entity_name: Eugene McDermott Library First Floor Group Study
cards.title: McDermott Library First Floor
cards.subtitle: Medium-noise group study at Eugene McDermott Library
cards.notes: Bring collaborators and work aloud at a moderate level; use this floor when your session needs conversation rather than a silent or quiet-study setting.
cards.short_summary: The library’s designated medium-noise area for collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: McDermott Library designates its first floor as medium-noise group study and identifies it as suitable for collaborative work or socialization.
cards.source_title: Library Policies | UT Dallas Eugene McDermott Library
cards.access_notes: UT Dallas affiliates use a valid Comet Card at library security gates; visitors must present government-issued photo ID and check in.

cards.entity_name: Eugene McDermott Library First Floor Atrium
cards.title: McDermott Library First-Floor Atrium
cards.subtitle: Quiet-to-moderate group seating in the library atrium
cards.notes: Set up at the atrium tables when your work benefits from group seating; keep volume within the library’s quiet-to-moderate expectation for this area.
cards.short_summary: An atrium seating area added to expand group-study capacity.
cards.evidence_claim: McDermott Library relocated study tables to its first-floor atrium for added group-study seating in a quiet-to-moderate noise area.
cards.source_title: Building Updates Coming This Summer - Eugene McDermott Library
cards.access_notes: Library access requires a Comet Card for UT Dallas affiliates; follow the posted noise expectations for the area.

cards.entity_name: Eugene McDermott Library Main Floor Single Carrels
cards.title: McDermott Library Single Carrels
cards.subtitle: Individual carrels on the library main floor
cards.notes: Choose a single carrel for a more self-contained setup and quiet work; keep calls, group work, and louder collaboration out of the study area.
cards.short_summary: Individual carrels installed to expand quiet-study options.
cards.evidence_claim: McDermott Library installed single carrels on its main floor to facilitate additional quiet study areas.
cards.source_title: Building Updates Coming This Summer - Eugene McDermott Library
cards.access_notes: Library entry requires a Comet Card for UT Dallas affiliates; carrels are in the library’s quiet-study environment.

cards.entity_name: Eugene McDermott Library Reservable Study Rooms
cards.title: McDermott Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Reservable individual and group rooms
cards.notes: Reserve ahead through the library system, bring your physical Comet Card for the key, and plan within the four-hour maximum and one active booking per day.
cards.short_summary: Bookable rooms for individual or group study with defined reservation rules.
cards.evidence_claim: Currently enrolled students can reserve McDermott Library study rooms during regular library hours; reservations are capped at four hours.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Study Room | UT Dallas Eugene McDermott Library
cards.access_notes: Available to currently enrolled students during regular library hours. A physical Comet Card is required to check out study-room keys.

cards.title: Student Union Study Lounges
cards.subtitle: Study lounges in the Student Union
cards.notes: Use the Student Union’s study lounges when you want a campus setting outside the library; check the building’s current access information before your visit.
cards.short_summary: A campus-union option that includes dedicated study lounges.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Dallas’s 2025 undergraduate catalog lists study lounges among the Student Union’s amenities and says the building is open seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Resources for Study and Campus Life - UT Dallas 2025 Undergraduate Catalog
cards.access_notes: The catalog states the Student Union is open seven days a week; verify current building access or event impacts before going.

cards.title: Student Services Building Common Areas
cards.subtitle: Common areas in the Student Services Building
cards.notes: Settle into a common area for independent work or an informal meeting, and check the building’s current hours or events before planning a longer session.
cards.short_summary: A seven-day campus building with common areas specifically described for studying.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Dallas’s 2025 undergraduate catalog says the Student Services Building is open seven days a week and provides common areas for studying and informal meetings.
cards.source_title: Resources for Study and Campus Life - UT Dallas 2025 Undergraduate Catalog
cards.access_notes: The catalog says the building is open seven days a week; verify current access and any scheduled functions before visiting.

cards.title: Student Services Addition Common Area
cards.subtitle: Common-area study space in the Student Services Addition
cards.notes: Use the addition’s common area for a relaxed study session or informal meeting, allowing for a more active environment than the library’s quiet floors.
cards.short_summary: A common-area setting intended for studying, meeting, and relaxing.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Dallas’s 2026 undergraduate catalog says the Student Services Addition has ample common-area space for formal and informal meetings, studying, and relaxing.
cards.source_title: Resources for Study and Campus Life - UT Dallas 2026 Undergraduate Catalog
cards.access_notes: The catalog says the building is open seven days a week; verify current access and room activity before visiting.
